ssh-lab-server.name: SSH hardening lab server (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
ssh-lab-server.notes: The target of the ssh-lab (vms/labs/ssh-lab/): an SSH server to harden, with fail2ban and knockd installed. The exercises tighten sshd_config, trigger and clear a fail2ban ban from the client on the lab segment, and hide SSH behind a port-knock sequence. fail2ban ignores the host-facing NAT network (10.0.2.0/24), so a demonstration ban on the segment never cuts off vmctl's own SSH. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image. Ported from qlab's ssh-lab.

write_files.content:
[DEFAULT]
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 10.0.2.0/24
bantime = 600
findtime = 600
maxretry = 3

[sshd]
enabled = true
port = ssh
backend = systemd

[options]
	UseSyslog

[openSSH]
	sequence    = 7000,8000,9000
	seq_timeout = 5
	command     = /usr/sbin/iptables -I KNOCKD_SSH -s %IP% -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
	tcpflags    = syn

[closeSSH]
	sequence    = 9000,8000,7000
	seq_timeout = 5
	command     = /usr/sbin/iptables -D KNOCKD_SSH -s %IP% -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
	tcpflags    = syn

#!/bin/sh
# SSH from the lab segment starts closed; a knock from the client opens it for that address.
# vmctl's own SSH arrives on the NAT NIC (10.0.2.x) and never enters this chain.
iptables -N KNOCKD_SSH 2>/dev/null || iptables -F KNOCKD_SSH
iptables -A KNOCKD_SSH -j DROP
iptables -C INPUT -s 172.20.2.0/24 -p tcp --dport 22 -j KNOCKD_SSH 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT -s 172.20.2.0/24 -p tcp --dport 22 -j KNOCKD_SSH

[Unit]
Description=ssh-lab: SSH from the lab segment closed until a port knock
Before=knockd.service
After=network-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/ssh-lab-knock-chain

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
After=network-online.target ssh-lab-knock-chain.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
# ssh-lan appears only at the runtime boot: retry until it is there.
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

runcmd: systemctl enable rsyslog fail2ban ssh-lab-knock-chain.service knockd.service

ssh-lab-client.name: SSH hardening lab client (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
ssh-lab-client.notes: The client of the ssh-lab (vms/labs/ssh-lab/): the machine the exercises drive to probe the server on the lab segment (nmap, knock, and a few deliberately wrong logins to show fail2ban react). Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image.
